summary: The menu is refreshed to 2026-11-17 (49 names, every F-score computable on all 9 tests). I rank by in-sector gross profitability first, then by cash flow backing earnings: VRSN (F9, 99th pct, CFO $1,091M vs NI $826M), CARG (F8, 100th pct, CFO $295M vs NI $156M) and DPZ (F8, 100th pct by a mislabelled sector, CFO $792M vs NI $602M) lead, with FTDR the best name not obviously held. The main accounting concerns are three names whose cash flow trails earnings (DORM worst, then GRMN with an amended-filing flag, then MLI), stale fiscal years at CLX, SMG and BLBD, ONC's amended-filing flag, and the same sector-label artifacts as in earlier runs. No Reviewer lesson names this role and I have no graded calls yet, so none shaped the ranking; I used the 11-16 L3 evidence only for the label caveats on MCO and MSCI.
